neutral.label: Neutral
neutral.description: Calm, balanced, matter-of-fact narration or ordinary conversation without strong emotion.
neutral.ref_text: The narrow stone bridge arched over the river, leading straight toward the old watchtower on the hill.
neutral.instruct: Speak in a clear, calm, natural storytelling voice.

warm.label: Warm
warm.description: Gentle affection, comfort, kindness, tenderness, or welcoming warmth.
warm.ref_text: Hey, come sit by the fire and rest for a while. I'm really glad you made it back safe tonight.
warm.instruct: Speak with warm, gentle affection, smiling softly through every word.

awed.label: Awed
awed.description: Breathless wonder, amazement, reverence, or spellbound discovery.
awed.ref_text: Look up at the vault above us... the entire cavern is carved from starlight, stretching on forever.
awed.instruct: Speak slowly in hushed, breathless awe and wonder, voice soft, lifted, and spellbound.

grim.label: Grim
grim.description: Dark, solemn, ominous, foreboding, or grave weight and dread.
grim.ref_text: Three kingdoms fell the last time that seal was broken, and tonight the ancient stones are cracking again.
grim.instruct: Speak in a grave, solemn, resolute narrator voice, low, steady, and heavy with dark weight.

somber.label: Somber
somber.description: Sorrow, grief, heartbreak, mourning, regret, or quiet sadness.
somber.ref_text: When the ash finally settled over the courtyard... there was nothing left, only silence and cold stone.
somber.instruct: Speak very slowly in a low, heavy, sorrowful voice, aching with quiet grief.

hushed.label: Hushed
hushed.description: Secretive whisper, stealth, hiding, or speaking very quietly so others do not overhear.
hushed.ref_text: Keep your head down and don't make a single sound... just take the brass key and slip out the back.
hushed.instruct: Speak in a very quiet, breathless, secretive whisper right next to the ear, hushed and airy.

tense.label: Tense
tense.description: Urgent alarm, immediate danger, combat pressure, panic-action, or high-stakes haste.
tense.ref_text: Get down behind the pillars right now! Lock the iron grate—something is coming fast up the stairs!
tense.instruct: Speak with sharp, breathless urgency and alarm! Voice loud, tight, strained, and fast!

angry.label: Angry
angry.description: Fierce anger, fury, outrage, sharp accusation, or heated confrontation.
angry.ref_text: Don't you dare lie to my face again! After everything you did to them, you don't get to ask for mercy!
angry.instruct: Speak with fierce, seething anger and sharp accusation! Voice hard, biting, forceful, and intense!

cold.label: Cold
cold.description: Icy, emotionless menace, detached hostility, disdain, or dangerous calm.
cold.ref_text: Touch that blade again, and you won't live long enough to regret it. Walk away while you still can.
cold.instruct: Speak in an icy, emotionless, quietly menacing voice, low, flat, slow, and dangerously calm.

fearful.label: Fearful
fearful.description: Trembling fear, terror, dread, pleading, or frightened hesitation.
fearful.ref_text: Don't go in there, please, I heard something breathing in the dark, and the door just locked behind us.
fearful.instruct: Speak in a trembling, frightened, breathless voice, shaky, hesitant, and scared.

weary.label: Weary
weary.description: Deep exhaustion, physical fatigue, burnout, injury strain, or heavy tired sighs.
weary.ref_text: I don't think I can walk another mile tonight... just let me lean against this wall and rest.
weary.instruct: Speak in a deeply exhausted, drained, breathless voice, slow and heavy with fatigue and tired sighs.

excited.label: Excited
excited.description: Bright joy, enthusiasm, triumph, delight, or high-spirited energy.
excited.ref_text: Wait, look at the archway—the runes are actually lighting up! It worked, we really opened it!
excited.instruct: Speak with bright, breathless excitement and radiant joy! Voice high, smiling, and energetic!

amused.label: Amused
amused.description: Lighthearted laughter, chuckling, humor, cheerful mirth, or finding something funny.
amused.ref_text: Haha, okay, I have to admit, watching that tiny cat steal your entire dinner was the best part of my week!
amused.instruct: Speak with warm, lighthearted laughter and bright amusement, smiling and chuckling happily through every word!

teasing.label: Teasing
teasing.description: Playful banter, smug smirk, witty provocation, sly drawl, or cheeky flirting.
teasing.ref_text: Oh, really? You walked straight into an obvious trap, and somehow I'm the one who needs rescuing?
teasing.instruct: Speak in a smug, playful, teasing drawl with a sly smirk in your voice, unhurried and full of attitude.

flustered.label: Flustered
flustered.description: Embarrassed, shy, caught off guard, blushing, stammering, or flabbergasted.
flustered.ref_text: Wait, what?! No, I wasn't staring at you—I was just checking if your cloak was crooked!
flustered.instruct: Speak in a flustered, embarrassed, flabbergasted tone! Voice light, nervous, quick, and sheepish!

horny.label: Horny
horny.description: Erotic arousal, breathless desire, sensual intimacy, seduction, or heavy lustful sighs.
horny.ref_text: Come a little closer... haah... don't stop now... haah... I can barely catch my breath when you touch me like that.
horny.instruct: Speak in a breathless, sultry, gasping close-mic voice, pausing for audible open-mouth breathy sighs and heavy catches of breath between phrases, warm and trembling with desire.
